dict.string: macOS only reveals WiFi network names and BSSIDs to apps with Location access. Recon Suite uses it to list nearby networks; your location is not read or stored.
macOS only reveals WiFi network names and BSSIDs to apps with Location access. Recon Suite uses it to list nearby networks; your location is not read or stored.
Recon Suite scans for nearby Bluetooth LE and Classic devices on request. Nothing is connected to or stored.
